name: Yuri Love Dungeon
source:
An overpowered succubus has entered a dungeon. Her influence is so strong that half the adventurers sent to remove her are painting hearts (or naughtier things) on the walls instead of fighting monsters, and, when a goblin leaps out, it’s as likely to try and snog you as attack you.

Play as either [Cleric] or [Ranger]. Both have been hopeless about love since wizarding school where they met a certain someone they cannot get out of their minds. Surely, the succubus' sensual power will have no effect on them! 

[From [url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/yuri-love-dungeon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个被制服的魅魔进入了地牢。她的影响力如此之大，以至于一半被派去除掉她的冒险者都在墙上画心（或更顽皮的东西），而不是与怪物战斗，而且，当妖精跳出来时，它很可能会试图亲吻你，就像攻击你一样。

扮演[Cleric]或[Ranger]。自从在魔法学校遇到了某个让他们无法忘怀的人以来，两人都对爱情感到绝望。当然，魅魔的肉欲之力对她们不会有任何影响！

[来自[url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/yuri-love-dungeon]itch.io[/url]]
